newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Zedillo to meet financiers in New York.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zedillo to meet financiers in New York.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo is due to travel to New York on Sunday and plans to meet the next day with members of the international financial community, government sources said on Tuesday.
A spokesman said the president would return to Mexico late on Monday. It would be his second visit to the U.S. financial center since he took office in December 1994.
According to Zedillo's preliminary agenda, he will breakfast on Monday with members of the Council on Foreign Relations, an organization that promotes the study of U.S. foreign policy.
Later, he will lunch with bankers and brokers in an event hosted by the Finance Ministry.
In the evening, he is scheduled to attend a dinner of the National Foreign Trade Council and will also meet major players in the U.S. media, the sources said.
